summary: a sweetness carried on wonders and worries of May's winter wind nostrils swim in scents still lingering. A friend who stayed too long, taste missed desperately when gone #smallpoems #PoemsOfPresence
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
a sweetness
carried on
wonders and
  worries of
May's winter
wind
  nostrils
swim in scents
  still lingering.
A friend who
stayed too long,
taste
missed
desperately
when gone

#PoemsOfPresence
